tasks.label: install-maven-and-test
tasks.command: $mavenHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.maven\apache-maven-3.9.9'; if (-not (Test-Path $mavenHome)) { $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'apache-maven-3.9.9-bin.zip'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.9.9/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.9-bin.zip' -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.maven') -Force }; & (Join-Path $mavenHome 'bin\mvn.cmd') test

tasks.label: download-maven-and-test
tasks.command: $mavenHome = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.maven\apache-maven-3.10.1'; if (-not (Test-Path $mavenHome)) { $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'apache-maven-3.10.1-bin.zip'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.10.1/binaries/apache-maven-3.10.1-bin.zip' -OutFile $zip; Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.maven') -Force }; & (Join-Path $mavenHome 'bin\mvn.cmd') test

tasks.label: test-auth-endpoints
tasks.command: $email = 'auth-test-' + [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds() + '@example.com'; $body = @{ email = $email; password = 'parola123' } | ConvertTo-Json; $register = Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/register' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; $login = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; $duplicateStatus = 0; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/register' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body | Out-Null } catch { $duplicateStatus = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode }; $wrongBody = @{ email = $email; password = 'parola-gresita' } | ConvertTo-Json; $wrongStatus = 0; try { Invoke-WebRequest -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $wrongBody | Out-Null } catch { $wrongStatus = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode }; Write-Output ('REGISTER_STATUS=' + [int]$register.StatusCode); Write-Output ('LOGIN_ROLE=' + $login.role); Write-Output ('LOGIN_EMAIL=' + $login.email); Write-Output ('DUPLICATE_REGISTER_STATUS=' + $duplicateStatus); Write-Output ('WRONG_PASSWORD_STATUS=' + $wrongStatus)

tasks.label: test-auth-endpoints-basic
tasks.command: $email = 'auth-test-' + [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds() + '@example.com'; $body = @{ email = $email; password = 'parola123' } | ConvertTo-Json; $register = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/register' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; $login = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; $duplicateStatus = 0; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/register' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body | Out-Null } catch { $duplicateStatus = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode }; $wrongBody = @{ email = $email; password = 'parola-gresita' } | ConvertTo-Json; $wrongStatus = 0; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method Post -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login' -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $wrongBody | Out-Null } catch { $wrongStatus = [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode }; Write-Output ('REGISTER_STATUS=' + [int]$register.StatusCode); Write-Output ('LOGIN_ROLE=' + $login.role); Write-Output ('LOGIN_EMAIL=' + $login.email); Write-Output ('DUPLICATE_REGISTER_STATUS=' + $duplicateStatus); Write-Output ('WRONG_PASSWORD_STATUS=' + $wrongStatus)

tasks.label: install-and-build-frontend
tasks.command: Set-Location frontend; npm install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm run build }

tasks.label: start-frontend-dev
tasks.command: Set-Location frontend; npm run dev -- --host localhost

tasks.label: verify-local-apps
tasks.command: $backend = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $frontend5173 = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:5173' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $frontend5174 = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:5174' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output ('BACKEND_STATUS=' + [int]$backend.StatusCode); Write-Output ('FRONTEND_5173_STATUS=' + [int]$frontend5173.StatusCode); Write-Output ('FRONTEND_5174_STATUS=' + [int]$frontend5174.StatusCode)
